Add `HPA`/`HVPA` handling to `HighAvailabilityConfig` webhook. (#7226)

This commit adds a special case handling, when the maxReplicas count
of H(V)PA objects is lower than the calculated replica count of the
deployment or statefulset.

Add `SystemComponentsConfig` Webhook (#7204)

* Copy generic set from Kubernetes source

This copy will be dropped once sources are updated to Kubernetes v1.26

* Add SystemComponentsConfig Webhook

* Let flow tasks for GRM to be ready

Steps that potentially deploy pods into the shoot cluster should wait
for GRM to be ready. This ensures, that potentially newly added taints
are added by the System Components Config webhook.

commit.message:
Introduce new `high-availability-config` webhook in `gardener-resource-manager` (#6967)

* Add new document about high availability conventions

* Add boilerplate for new `highavailabilityconfig` webhook

It will be filled with logic in the subsequent commits.

* Add boilerplate for integration test

It will be filled with logic in the subsequent commits.

* Mutate replicas

* Mutate node affinity

* Mutate topology spread constraints

* Drop manual TSC configuration for `kube-apiserver`

In the future (not part of this PR), the HA config will be injected via the new webhook.

* Enable new webhook in `resourcemanager` component

* Enable `podtopologyspreadconstraints` webhook for shoot

On the way, the `resourcemanager`'s values are sorted in the seed controller for easier readability/maintenance.

* Simplify `botanist.DeploySeedNamespace` unit tests

* Adapt shoot controller to properly label/annotate seed namespace

* Shoot controller considers currently in-use zones when annotating seed namespace

* Specify zones for local kind clusters

* Adapt shoot controller to properly label/annotate `kube-system` namespace

* Adapt seed controller to properly label/annotate namespaces

* Enable skipping HA config webhook for dedicated components

* Adapt `gardenlet` to match seed component conventions

- `gardenlet` is special since it's the root component in a seed cluster, hence it cannot rely on the new `high-availability-config` webhook
- It is skipped from the webhook
- We have to manually follow the conventions in the chart now

* Adapt `gardener-resource-manager` to match seed component conventions

- `gardener-resource-manager` is special since it's serveing the the new `high-availability-config` webhook, hence it cannot rely on it
- The GRM in the seed running in `garden` cluster is skipped from the webhook
- We have to manually follow the conventions in the component now
- The GRM in the seed running in shoot namespaces is NOT skipped from the webhook (it will be handled by it)

* Address PR review feedback

* Use `autoscaling/v2` for HPAs when target version `>= 1.23`

* Address PR review feedback

* Adapt e2e upgrade test TSC assertions

* Adapt e2e upgrade test affinity assertions

* Address PR review feedback

* Fix nit in docs

* Add missing RBAC rules

* Remove duplicative rule for PVCs

Streamline `gardener-resource-manager` entrypoint and introduce component configuration (#6865)

* Rename `webhooks` packages to `webhook`

Typically we use singular for these names (e.g. there is also `controller` package and not `controllerS`)

* Drop unused/dead code

* -------- empty separator commit --------

* Introduce component config API types

* API defaulting

* API validation

* Run code generation

* -------- empty separator commit --------

* Move health check to `healthz` package

* Align entrypoints of binaries

* Rework main entrypoint

* -------- empty separator commit --------

* Switch kubelet-csr-approver controller

* Switch garbage-collector controller

* Switch health controller

* Switch managed-resource controller

* Switch root-ca-publisher controller

* Switch secret controller

* Switch token-invalidator controller

* Switch token-requestor controller

* -------- empty separator commit --------

* Switch pod-scheduler-name webhook

* Switch pod-topology-spread-constraint webhook

* Switch pod-zone-affinity webhook

* Switch projected-token-mount webhook

* Switch seccomp-profile webhook

* Switch token-invalidator webhook

* -------- empty separator commit --------

* Adapt botanist and component

Instead of computing CLI flags, we now compute the configuration - much cleaner.

* Adapt Helm chart

* Address PR review feedback

* Address PR review feedback

* Do not restrict target cluster to kube-system namespace

This was also not done before but a premature optimization as part of
this PR. However, we have to revert it because the GRM for shoots
handles not only the kube-system namespace in the shoot but also other
namespaces (e.g., kubernetes-dashboard).
